function.name: add_room
function.description: Add a new room. The room starts with no links; link it with add_link.

x.description: A point inside the room. Horizontal position on the 0-1000 grid, 0 = left edge of the image.

y.description: A point inside the room. Vertical position on the 0-1000 grid, 0 = top edge of the image.

label.description: The room's name as it should be shown, for example 'Master bedroom'.

size.description: Room size on the 0-1000 grid: the radius of a circle with the room's area.

function.name: move_room
function.description: Move a room to a new position. Its links and type stay as they are.

x.description: New position. Horizontal position on the 0-1000 grid, 0 = left edge of the image.

y.description: New position. Vertical position on the 0-1000 grid, 0 = top edge of the image.

function.name: delete_room
function.description: Delete a room and every link that touches it.

function.name: set_room_type
function.description: Change a room's type, for example from bedroom to office (type 'other').

function.name: set_room_label
function.description: Rename a room. An empty label removes the name.

label.description: The new name. Use an empty string to remove the name.

function.name: add_link
function.description: Link two rooms on the same floor that are not linked yet. Use kind 'wall' to say that two rooms are next to each other with a wall between them. A door or opening needs that wall first: add a 'wall' link, then change it with set_link_kind. Rooms that are already linked are changed only with set_link_kind.

kind.description: Use 'wall'. For a door or opening, add a wall, then use set_link_kind.

function.name: remove_link
function.description: Remove the link between two rooms completely, so they are no longer adjacent. To close a door in a wall that stays, use set_link_kind with kind 'wall' instead.

function.name: set_link_kind
function.description: Change how two already linked rooms connect (door, opening, wall).

kind.description: The new kind: door, opening, or wall.

function.name: add_exterior_door
function.description: Mark that an exterior door opens into a room (any outside door, not only the front door).

room_id.description: The room the outside door opens into.

function.name: remove_exterior_door
function.description: Remove the exterior door from a room (it no longer has a door to the outside).

room_id.description: The room that has the outside door.

function.name: new_plan
function.description: Draw a whole new plan from scratch. It replaces the current plan, so use it only when there is nothing to keep; to change the current plan use the other tools.

plan.description: The plan as compact JSON on one line: rooms (id r0, r1, ..., type, xy on the 0-1000 grid, size = the radius of a circle with the room's area on the same grid, optional label, optional entrance: true for a room an outside door opens into) and links [a, b, kind] with kind door, opening or wall. For example: {"rooms":[{"id":"r0","type":"entry","xy":[474,735],"size":52,"entrance":true},{"id":"r1","type":"living","label":"OH","xy":[583,295],"size":160}],"links":[["r0","r1","door"]]}
